title: Drop errored rows before interval pairs them
description: src/cli.mjs's interval branch loads rows.json as-is and pairedInterval/singleSampleInterval average every row, including rows whose cell errored. Errored rows still carry rulesScore, judgeScore and total: in 2026-09-05T13-02-20-890Z, a reply that was only Claude Code's spend-limit message scored judge 1.0 and rules 0.92. Any interval over a run with errored cells is silently contaminated. COS-31 hit this on its reserve validation and worked around it by filtering rows into scratchpad files before calling interval. The fix belongs in interval itself, sitting beside COS-35's guards on the same function.

acceptanceCriteria.text: interval (both --before/--after and --rows) excludes rows with a truthy error field before grouping, and prints how many it dropped per side
A test that fails without the change: a fixture with one errored row scored judge 1.0 shifts the paired mean unless excluded

Re-running COS-31 reserve comparison (before 2026-09-05T13-02-20-890Z + 2026-10-05T21-50-08-914Z, after 2026-10-05T19-04-48-633Z) through the CLI with no pre-filtering reproduces judge +12.3 [+5.4, +19.2]

plan: 1. Filter in interval.mjs, not only the CLI, so every caller is covered: pairedInterval and singleSampleInterval drop rows with a truthy error before grouping and return the dropped count (dropped: {before, after} for paired, dropped: n for single).
2. cli.mjs interval prints the dropped counts per side, in both modes, on stderr so stdout keeps its one-line figure.

3. Tests in test/interval.test.mjs: one errored row scored 1.0 shifts the mean unless excluded (verify it fails with the filter removed); dropped counts are reported; a key whose only rows errored raises the existing missing-key error.
4. AC #3: rerun COS-31 reserve comparison through the CLI unfiltered and confirm judge +12.3 [+5.4, +19.2].
5. Full test suite and audit pass. COS-35 multi-style guards stay out of scope.
implementationNotes: Filter lives in interval.mjs (dropErrored), not only the CLI, so both pairedInterval and singleSampleInterval are covered for any caller; cli.mjs is the only caller today. Return shapes gain dropped: {before, after} (paired) and dropped: n (single); the CLI prints them to stderr every time, including 0, so stdout keeps its one-line figure. A key whose only rows errored now raises the existing missing-key error rather than pairing on nothing. Usage text updated.

Verification. Before the fix the CLI read COS-31's reserve comparison (before 2026-09-05T13-02-20-890Z + 2026-10-05T21-50-08-914Z, after 2026-10-05T19-04-48-633Z) as rules +0.6 [-0.7,+1.8], judge +10.1 [+1.0,+19.2], composite +4.4 [+0.2,+8.5], words +6.3 [-14.7,+27.4]. After: 'dropped errored rows: before 44, after 0' then rules +0.7 [-0.2,+1.7], judge +12.3 [+5.4,+19.2], composite +5.3 [+2.3,+8.4], words -3.7 [-13.2,+5.9], matching COS-31's hand-filtered figures exactly (AC #3). Five new tests in test/interval.test.mjs; with dropErrored made to keep every row, 4 fail (the fifth asserts dropped=0 on clean rows and passes either way) (AC #2). Full suite 240/240, audit: all 12 checks agree.

Published figures: scanned every results/ run holding errored rows against FINDINGS.md and docs/. No published interval moves. 22-59-53 (the Haiku baseline COS-19 pairs against) has 6 errored rows, all on agentic-fix-verify and reserve-agentic-write, outside the shared five COS-19 pairs on. 2026-08-28T03-13-14 is already cited by its non-errored count. The experiment ledger lists other errored runs but cites them as run records, not as interval inputs.
finalSummary: interval now drops rows whose cell errored before grouping, in both modes, and prints how many it dropped from each side. Errored rows carry scores (a spend-limit message scored judge 1.0), and averaging them in had moved COS-31's reserve judge figure from +12.3 to +10.1 and flipped words from -3.7 to +6.3. Fixed in interval.mjs so every caller is covered. Verified: 5 new tests, 4 of which fail with the filter removed; full suite 240/240; audit clean; the CLI now reproduces COS-31's hand-filtered reserve figures exactly with no pre-filtering. No published interval changes: the errored rows in cited runs fall outside the cases those intervals pair on.
